question: Should the Android app expose a first-class system Sharesheet target that imports external content into the existing chat composer?
rationale: This introduces a new exported Android intent surface and user-facing entry workflow; the direction aligns with VISION.md, but Android ownership must confirm the product behavior and active-draft policy before the implementation lands.

options.title: Sponsor after safety repair
options.body: Keep the linked pull request as the canonical implementation, require active-draft preservation or confirmation, and obtain real Android runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Decline the native entry point
options.body: Close this issue and the linked pull request if OpenClaw should not appear as an Android Sharesheet target.
